adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new code does take `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` with no explicit max, but the finding’s claim that “the old code at least capped … at 200” is not supported by the diff: the previous automatic-group branch also used `(params[:limit] || 200).to_i` with no upper bound, so `?limit=999999` would already have been possible. Additionally, previously non-automatic groups had *no* limit/offset at all (returned all members), so this change does not clearly introduce the alleged ability/regression; it actually adds pagination by default.
